name: Kin'iro no Corda 3
source:
8 years after the adventures of Hino Kahoko, it is now time for Kohinata Kanade to step onto the stage.

Soon after transferring to Seisou Academy, Kanade finds the orchestra club in the middle of preparing for the National concert. Teaming up with the other members, she will improve her skills, meet new rivals and create memories for what will become an unforgettable summer...
translation:
在日野香穗子的冒险结束8年之后，轮到小日向奏登上舞台了。

转入星奏学院后不久，奏发现管弦乐社团正在为全国音乐会做准备。与其他成员一起，她将提升自己的技艺，遇到新的对手，创造将成为难忘夏天的回忆……
